summary: FEMSA filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a CHF 300 million 5-year senior unsecured bond placement in the Swiss market, to be listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. The bonds price at 107 basis points over the relevant benchmark, for a yield of 1.73%, with ratings of BBB+ from S&P Global Ratings and A from Fitch Ratings. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, improving cost of debt and financial flexibility. No equity, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or change-of-control element is present; this is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation.
